chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, raising it from them (peace be upon him), said:
He (peace be upon him) said: 'The one who bequeaths with the one-third, it would be reckoned for him from his Zakat'.
ai.seo_question: How is the one-third bequest treated in relation to Zakat calculations?
ai.summary: In this concise ruling from *Al-Kafi*, the scholar highlights a specific interaction between testamentary bequests and obligatory almsgiving, indicating that the one-third portion designated for a will is deducted from the Zakat liability of the estate. This reflects the Shia jurisprudential principle of avoiding double burden on the deceased's wealth, ensuring that the charitable obligation is calculated on the net distributable assets after fulfilling the testator's final wishes.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, 
(It has been narrated) raising it from them<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘
The one who bequeaths with the one-third, it would be reckoned for him from his Zakat’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated in a marfu‘ the following: “‘A’immah, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, have said, ‘
If one makes a will about one-third of his legacy it is counted as his Zakat.’”
